top_signals.title: What lessons can we learn from declining carrier schedule adherence and rising port congestion?
top_signals.summary: Schedule reliability has fallen to near record lows in recent months, while port congestion has built up. In this opinion piece, Drewry experts draw the main lessons from the operational problems of the 2026 peak season to inform concerned shippers, forwarders, carriers and ports. Look at it from the viewpoint of a shipper moving goods ...
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
